sections.title: Lesson 1: Atomic Structure
objective: Count subatomic particles in neutral atoms
concept: The nucleus contains protons (positive) and neutrons (neutral). Electrons orbit outside the nucleus.

example.problem: How many protons, neutrons, and electrons are in a neutral atom of $^{27}\text{Al}$ (Z=13)?

items.q: The number of protons in the nucleus of $^{32}\text{P}$ (Z=15) is:
What is the total number of electrons in an atom with atomic number 13 and mass number 27?
Explain why atoms are electrically neutral.
items.answer: Atoms have equal numbers of protons and electrons, so the positive and negative charges cancel.
